name: TRAIN AT SIX
description: is a luxury fitness, wellness, and co-working destination located in Canggu, Bali. It features three floors of air-conditioned fitness studios with state-of-the-art equipment, a wide variety of classes, professional trainers, and recovery services like sports massages and a cold plunge pool. The club aims to be an inclusive community space that also includes co-working facilities and amenities like a rooftop pool.
